headline: Vancouver's soccer ball gets second life as bags and umbrellas
meta_description: Vancouver's iconic 'Beautiful Dome' soccer ball has been repurposed into bags and umbrellas, raising $70,000 for Science World.
summary_short: Vancouver transforms a beloved soccer ball into practical items—and funds a beloved institution in the process.
body:
Vancouver's iconic 'Beautiful Dome' soccer ball has been repurposed into bags and umbrellas, raising $70,000 for Science World.

The creative upcycling project gave new life to the recognizable spherical landmark while supporting the science museum's mission. By transforming the soccer ball into functional everyday items, the initiative turned a symbol of the city into products that supporters could take home and use.

The $70,000 raised demonstrates how clever repurposing can serve both environmental and charitable goals at once—keeping materials out of waste streams while channeling funds toward community education and public engagement with science.
